Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":160,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"}],"nextLine":161}]

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":160,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"}],"nextLine":161}]

Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":160,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"}],"nextLine":161}]

The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. // R-rewire-deferred (D47): defer a self-dep-set mutation to the committed boundary.

unsubscribeDep: (dep, fn) => self._requestRewireNext({ kind: "remove", dep, fn }),

Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":160,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"}],"nextLine":161}]

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. What the adapter does. `mountSpendingAlertsDisplay` takes an already-created `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback, subscribes to the view's five business ports (`assessment`, `publication`, `coverage`, `issues`, `startup`), and renders the current available values together with an explicit `unavailable` list. It creates no instance, no input facts and no business state; it only observes the original view (README.md:34, causal-view-binding.ts:1-2).

The view is exactly the frozen object built in causal-preset.ts:171-177 (`assessment`, `publication`, `coverage`, `issues`, `startup`), and `SpendingAlertsView` is its type (causal-preset.ts:206). Each port is a `Node<T>`, so `ValueOf` extracts the payload type (causal-view-binding.ts:5-8).

The adapter therefore renders the latest value per port, which is explicitly not an atomic multi-port snapshot and not independent evidence (causal-view-binding.ts:9-13; README.md:142).

It is a per-port observation, not a statement that the run ended: business stop, node `COMPLETE` and run termination are distinct, and the protocol has no END message (README.md:153-157).

Unmounting stops observation; the running instance keeps its outstanding obligations, retained request/admission/outcome records and bounded retention (README.md:143, 146-151). Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. What the code does. `spendingAlertsFor(graph, defaults)` binds one immutable default set and returns a frozen `compose` (causal-entry.ts:48-77). `configuration` freezes `{name, diagnostics}` and defaults diagnostics to "off" (causal-entry.ts:36-46), so the shared defaults are `{name: "alerts-a", diagnostics: "off"}`. Each `compose(inputs, overrides)` re-validates the caller's plain input object, requires a prepared `SpendingResource` (`SpendingResource.is`, causal-entry.ts:54-58), and calls the existing complete host construction `composeSpendingHost(graph, inputs, resource.binding, resource, options)` (causal-entry.ts:59-69). It returns the host plus `view` and `capabilities` (causal-entry.ts:70-74). The two calls therefore produce two independent runtimes in the same Graph, with distinct names `alerts-a`/`alerts-b` and `diagnostics: "summary"` only on the second. `mountSpendingView(view, render)` subscribes the five ports of that exact view and returns a stop function that ends observation only (causal-view-binding.ts:16-56). The returned pair exposes each original instance and its own cleanup.

What the application must retain after either display is unmounted. Detaching a panel stops observation; it does not close the instance or release its obligations (README.md:143, causal-view-binding.ts:16). The application must keep, per instance: (1) the owning Graph and the original composed instance (`app.owner`, `app.inspect`, `app.runEndReady`, `app.guard`, `app.source`) — the demo keeps `app.owner` and `app.inspect` (causal-graded-demo.ts:65, 140-143, 185-188); (2) the original `.view` and the original issued capabilities, including `capabilities.retained` lineage, because frameworks pass the original identity/execution/retained handles and a structural copy is not an issued object (README.md:91-96, causal-audience.examples.ts:17-25); (3) the host's retained request/admission/outcome records, which survive detach and are bounded at 64 per owned epoch with one in-flight write (README.md:146-151, causal-focused-host.ts:140, 368-373, 571-575); (4) the request references needed to correlate the publication projection with those records (README.md:125-132, causal-graded-demo.ts:207-211). A missing publication does not mean no request was submitted, and `runEndReady`/`normalEndReady` are readiness conditions, not proof of termination or resource release (README.md:129-132, 144).

Distinct names. The name is a node-namespace prefix, not an authorization token: `spendingNodeNames` builds `${name}/startup`, `${name}/...`, `${name}/causal/...`, `${name}/publication` and, only for `diagnostics === "summary"`, `${name}/diagnosticSummary` (causal-preset.ts:60-72). Distinct names keep the two instances' nodes and edges distinguishable in one Graph, and the host guard checks `view.authorityId === `${name}/causal/authority`` (causal-focused-host.ts:310-311). Changing a name does not clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding (README.md:85-89).

Independently prepared input Nodes. `spendingInputNodes` requires four exact groups and six distinct input Nodes (causal-preset.ts:73-93); the host wires `inputs.evaluations.pack/arrivals/current`, `inputs.verification.receipts` and `inputs.localAuthority.facts` as its declared edges (causal-focused-host.ts:88-94). Each input frame is validated against the expected binding (`checkInput`, causal-inputs.ts:352-437), and the host's guard requires the material snapshot's `packRef` to match the binding (causal-focused-host.ts:309-313). Two independently prepared inputs give each instance its own evaluation/verification/authority facts and its own occurrence identity, so one instance's facts cannot be substituted for the other's; the demo prepares separate `sources` and `sourcesB` (causal-graded-demo.ts:46, 95).

Resource bindings. `compose` requires a prepared resource and passes `resource.binding` and the resource itself to the host (causal-entry.ts:55-68). The host validates the binding and requires `same(resource.binding, binding)` (causal-focused-host.ts:74-77), then `resource.claim()` takes the single cold lease for that resource (causal-focused-host.ts:96, causal-resource.ts:69-99). A resource can be claimed once, so two instances need two separately prepared resources with their own bindings (compositionEpoch/hostEpoch/destinationRef); the demo uses `presetBinding` and a second `bindingB` with `compositionEpoch: 2`, `hostEpoch: 2` (causal-graded-demo.ts:89-110). The binding is what ties the instance's material, admission and publication to one destination and epoch; changing a name does not rebind it.

It returns the host plus `view` and `capabilities` (causal-entry.ts:70-74). The two calls therefore produce two independent runtimes in the same Graph, with distinct names `alerts-a`/`alerts-b` and `diagnostics: "summary"` only on the second. `mountSpendingView(view, render)` subscribes the five ports of that exact view and returns a stop function that ends observation only (causal-view-binding.ts:16-56). The returned pair exposes each original instance and its own cleanup.

What the application must retain after either display is unmounted. Detaching a panel stops observation; it does not close the instance or release its obligations (README.md:143, causal-view-binding.ts:16). The application must keep, per instance: (1) the owning Graph and the original composed instance (`app.owner`, `app.inspect`, `app.runEndReady`, `app.guard`, `app.source`) — the demo keeps `app.owner` and `app.inspect` (causal-graded-demo.ts:65, 140-143, 185-188); (2) the original `.view` and the original issued capabilities, including `capabilities.retained` lineage, because frameworks pass the original identity/execution/retained handles and a structural copy is not an issued object (README.md:91-96, causal-audience.examples.ts:17-25); (3) the host's retained request/admission/outcome records, which survive detach and are bounded at 64 per owned epoch with one in-flight write (README.md:146-151, causal-focused-host.ts:140, 368-373, 571-575); (4) the request references needed to correlate the publication projection with those records (README.md:125-132, causal-graded-demo.ts:207-211). A missing publication does not mean no request was submitted, and `runEndReady`/`normalEndReady` are readiness conditions, not proof of termination or resource release (README.md:129-132, 144).

Distinct names. The name is a node-namespace prefix, not an authorization token: `spendingNodeNames` builds `${name}/startup`, `${name}/...`, `${name}/causal/...`, `${name}/publication` and, only for `diagnostics === "summary"`, `${name}/diagnosticSummary` (causal-preset.ts:60-72). Distinct names keep the two instances' nodes and edges distinguishable in one Graph, and the host guard checks `view.authorityId === `${name}/causal/authority`` (causal-focused-host.ts:310-311). Changing a name does not clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding (README.md:85-89).

Independently prepared input Nodes. `spendingInputNodes` requires four exact groups and six distinct input Nodes (causal-preset.ts:73-93); the host wires `inputs.evaluations.pack/arrivals/current`, `inputs.verification.receipts` and `inputs.localAuthority.facts` as its declared edges (causal-focused-host.ts:88-94). Each input frame is validated against the expected binding (`checkInput`, causal-inputs.ts:352-437), and the host's guard requires the material snapshot's `packRef` to match the binding (causal-focused-host.ts:309-313). Two independently prepared inputs give each instance its own evaluation/verification/authority facts and its own occurrence identity, so one instance's facts cannot be substituted for the other's; the demo prepares separate `sources` and `sourcesB` (causal-graded-demo.ts:46, 95).

Resource bindings. `compose` requires a prepared resource and passes `resource.binding` and the resource itself to the host (causal-entry.ts:55-68). The host validates the binding and requires `same(resource.binding, binding)` (causal-focused-host.ts:74-77), then `resource.claim()` takes the single cold lease for that resource (causal-focused-host.ts:96, causal-resource.ts:69-99). A resource can be claimed once, so two instances need two separately prepared resources with their own bindings (compositionEpoch/hostEpoch/destinationRef); the demo uses `presetBinding` and a second `bindingB` with `compositionEpoch: 2`, `hostEpoch: 2` (causal-graded-demo.ts:89-110). The binding is what ties the instance's material, admission and publication to one destination and epoch; changing a name does not rebind it.

Scope. The snippet only composes and mounts; it does not open resources, invent input facts or call a transport. Normal host behavior (including the simulated writer) is left intact.

explains how an anomalous transaction produces an alert message. The private Causal
integration demonstrates admission, retained obligations and graded consumption
with an **offline simulated writer**. Neither command writes a real inbox.

### Choose the boundary you already have
These helpers are consumer-private source imports, **not published package
subpaths**. Start with the object supplied to your component:
| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |

| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |

| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |

| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |

| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host.
